title: Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) Bridge Notice of Intent to Sole Source
description: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency intends to issue a sole-source bridge IDIQ contract to Leidos for Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) under RFO 6.103-1(c)(2), supporting the FS2 program through April 2028 until a competitive follow-on IDIQ can be awarded. Scope: continued integration, software maintenance, operations support and limited development for current mission capabilities of the Source Directorate, across Mapping, Charting and Geodesy mission areas: aeronautical, maritime, topographic, geopolitical geography, elevation, geodesy and controlled imagery.
